::: {#sol-irls-step}

Here the rows of $X$ are $(1, -1)$ for the three patients in the group coded $-1$ and $(1, 1)$ for the three treated patients,
and $\voutvar = \tp{(0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1)}$.

**1.** At $\vcoef^* = \vzero$ every fitted [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) is $\sigmoidf{0} = 1/2$,
so every weight is $w_{\iobs} = (1/2)(1/2) = 1/4$.
The working responses are $z_{\iobs} = 0 + \paren{\outvar_{\iobs} - 1/2} / (1/4) = 4 \outvar_{\iobs} - 2$:

$$
\vecf{z} = \tp{(-2, -2, 2, -2, 2, 2)}.
$$

**2.** With $W = \tfrac{1}{4} \matr{I}_6$,

$$
\qform{W}{X}
= \tfrac{1}{4}
\begin{bmatrix} 6 & 0 \\ 0 & 6 \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} 3/2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3/2 \end{bmatrix},
$$

because the entries of the first column of $X$ sum to $6$, the squares in the second column sum to $6$,
and the two columns multiply to a sum of $-3 + 3 = 0$.
The first entry of $\tp{X} W \vecf{z}$ is $\tfrac{1}{4}(-2 - 2 + 2 - 2 + 2 + 2) = 0$,
and the second is $\tfrac{1}{4}\paren{(-1)(-2 - 2 + 2) + (1)(-2 + 2 + 2)} = \tfrac{1}{4}(2 + 2) = 1$,
so $\tp{X} W \vecf{z} = \tp{(0, 1)}$.

**3.** The updated coefficients are

$$
\begin{bmatrix} 2/3 & 0 \\ 0 & 2/3 \end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 2/3 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

The [intercept](correlation-regression.qmd#def-slr-intercept) stays at $0$ and the [slope](correlation-regression.qmd#def-slr-slope) moves from $0$ to $2/3$.

:::
